name: components-community-radial-nav
title: Radial Nav
description: Five icon buttons sit on a thin circular track; selecting one stretches it into a pill with its label and swings a small arrow in the middle to point at it.
use: A compact menu needs five or so destinations in little space and can afford a circular footprint.
avoid: The ring wastes space in corners, and long expanded labels need a wide parent or they overlap the track.
a11y: Buttons have labels and a pressed state, but there are no focus-visible rings, so keyboard focus is invisible on the dark track. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A thin white circle on black with five round outlined buttons spaced around its rim, each holding a black-line icon. The selected one widens into a rounded pill showing its icon and name, and a small cursor arrow sits in the middle.
behaves: Clicking a node expands that button into a labelled pill and shrinks the previous one back to a circle, while a spring rotates the centred pointer the shortest way to face the chosen item.
customise: Items with icon, label and angle, the circle size, menu-button sizing and a default active id are props; the ring geometry and springs are fixed in source.
weight: light: Five small buttons and one rotating icon; nothing animates at rest.
demo: Home, Search, Notifications, Profile and Settings icons arranged around the ring.
issues: The expanded Notifications pill spills past the circle and crowds the ring edge.
The active arrow is small and can read as a stray mouse cursor.
polishWhy: Crisp line work and a neat pointer; the long label spilling outside the ring is the main flaw.
